dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi! What can I get you?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! ˈwʌt kən aɪ ˈɡɛt juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: An iced tea, please. Less sugar.
dialogue.reading: ən ˈaɪst ˈtiː, ˈpliːz. ˈlɛs ˈʃʊɡər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A hot latte with more milk, please.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈhɑːt ˈlɑːteɪ wɪð ˈmɔːr ˈmɪlk, ˈpliːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, and can I have a straw, please?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ənd kən aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈstrɔː, ˈpliːz?
